fields.subject: Requesting a refund — signed up by mistake
fields.body: I upgraded to the annual Pro plan yesterday but meant to pick monthly. Can I get a refund and switch? Charged €120.
fields.reason: Refund request within the 30-day window (charged yesterday). KB confirms eligibility, but refunds are approval-required — do not send until the operator approves.
fields.suggested-reply: Hi Marta, you're well within our 30-day window, so I can refund the €120 annual charge to your original card (5–10 business days) and get you set up on the monthly Pro plan instead. I'll process that refund right away.

fields.subject: How do I export all my notes?
fields.body: Leaving for a new job and want a backup of everything before my seat is removed. What's the best way?
fields.reason: Straightforward export how-to. Answer grounded in the export KB article; large-workspace note included in case the backup is big.
fields.suggested-reply: Hi David! Head to Settings → Data → Export and choose Markdown, PDF, or a full ZIP archive. If your workspace is large (10k+ notes) it'll run in the background and email you a download link within an hour — the link is good for 24 hours. Want me to trigger the export for you?

fields.subject: URGENT: PDF export failing for the whole team before an audit
fields.body: We have an audit tomorrow and every PDF export errors out at 90%. This is blocking 12 people. Please help ASAP.
fields.reason: Urgent, multi-user export failure blocking a deadline; SLA already breached (due 07:00). Draft acknowledges + proposes escalation to engineering.
fields.suggested-reply: Hi Lena, I'm sorry this is hitting right before your audit — I've flagged it as urgent. As an immediate workaround, a Markdown or ZIP export from Settings → Data → Export should go through while we investigate the PDF path. I'm escalating the failing PDF job to our engineering on-call now and will update you within the hour.

fields.subject: Notes from my laptop aren't showing on my phone
fields.body: Edited a bunch of notes on my laptop last night, phone still shows the old version. Did I lose my work?
fields.reason: Classic stale-device sync issue. Reply reassures no data loss and walks the KB resync steps. SLA breached (due 06:30).
fields.suggested-reply: Hi Ji-ho — good news, nothing is lost. This is usually a stale device: make sure your phone is online, pull down to refresh the workspace, and if it's still behind, sign out and back in to force a full resync. If two versions ever conflict we keep both as a 'Conflicted copy' note, so your edits are safe.

fields.subject: Remove two seats after layoffs
fields.body: We let two people go this week. How do I remove their seats and will we be credited?
fields.reason: Seat-removal billing question. Answer grounded in the seats KB; credit behavior stated exactly as documented.
fields.suggested-reply: Hi Rosa, so sorry to hear that. As the workspace owner you can remove seats in Settings → Billing → Team — the change takes effect immediately, and the unused portion of each removed seat is credited to your next invoice automatically. Nothing else needed on your side.

fields.subject: Locked out — lost my phone with the 2FA app
fields.body: New phone, old one is gone, and I can't log in. Can you just turn off 2FA on my account?
fields.reason: 2FA reset request. Draft leaned toward disabling 2FA — human asked to require identity verification per the security KB.
fields.suggested-reply: Hi Greg, I can help you back in. First, do you still have one of the recovery codes you saved when enabling 2FA? If so, use it at the login screen. If not, I'll need to verify your identity before making any change — I'll never disable 2FA on an unverified request, for your account's safety.
fields.decision-comment: Require identity verification first — never disable 2FA on an unverified request. Ask for the recovery code.

fields.subject: Third time the app logged me out mid-writing
fields.body: This is really frustrating — I lost my train of thought twice today because the app randomly logs me out.
fields.reason: Frustrated but retainable Pro user. Draft validates the frustration, gives the resync fix, and sets expectations. Approved to send.
fields.suggested-reply: Bruno, I completely understand — getting bounced out mid-thought is the worst. This is usually a session/sync hiccup rather than lost work (drafts autosave). Try signing out and back in once to refresh the session; if it keeps happening I'll pull your session logs and dig in personally. Thanks for sticking with us.
fields.decision-comment: Send as is — good tone, lead with the re-login fix, offer to dig into session logs.

fields.subject: Please add nested tags
fields.body: We'd love nested/hierarchical tags for organizing client work. Any plans?
fields.reason: Feature request — no KB answer exists. Draft acknowledges, sets honest expectations, and logs it for product. No commitment made.
fields.suggested-reply: Hi Mei, thanks for the thoughtful suggestion — nested tags is a popular ask and I've logged your vote for it with our product team. I can't promise a date, but requests like yours genuinely shape the roadmap. I'll note your workspace so we can reach out if it ships.

fields.subject: Need a proper invoice (fapiao) for accounting
fields.body: Our finance team needs a formal invoice for the Business plan. Can you send one for last month?
fields.reason: Invoice/fapiao request — no self-serve KB path for CN invoices, so route to billing ops. Draft acknowledges and sets a timeline. SLA breached.
fields.suggested-reply: Hi Liu, happy to sort that out. Formal invoices for the Business plan are issued by our billing team — I've forwarded your request and they'll email the invoice for last month within one business day. Please confirm the company title and tax ID you'd like on it.

fields.subject: Password reset email not arriving
fields.body: I keep requesting a reset but the email never comes.
fields.reason: Reset email deliverability — resolved by asking to check spam and allowlist. Customer confirmed and rated 5/5.
fields.suggested-reply: Hi Thandi! Reset emails sometimes land in spam or get held by strict filters. Please check your spam/junk folder and allowlist no-reply@nimbusnotes.example, then request the reset once more. If it still doesn't arrive in 5 minutes, reply here and I'll trigger it manually.
fields.csat-comment: Fixed in minutes, super clear. Thank you!

fields.subject: How do I share a note with someone outside my team?
fields.body: Want to send a read-only note to a client who isn't in our workspace.
fields.reason: Share-link how-to, resolved same day. Customer rated 4/5.
fields.suggested-reply: Hi Yara! Open the note, tap Share, and choose 'Anyone with the link (view only)'. You can copy that link to your client — they won't need an account, and you can revoke it anytime from the same menu.
fields.csat-comment: Worked, thanks. Would be nice to set link expiry.

fields.subject: Partnership opportunity 🚀 10x your users
fields.body: Guaranteed traffic and crypto payouts, reply for our rate card.
fields.reason: Unsolicited spam pitch, not a support request. Blocked — no reply, no action.
fields.decision-comment: Spam pitch, not a support request. Block, no reply.

fields.subject: Difference between Pro and Team?
fields.body: Thinking of upgrading — what do we get on Team vs Pro?
fields.reason: Plan-comparison question, resolved in chat. Rated 5/5.
fields.suggested-reply: Hi Giulia! Team adds shared workspaces, per-seat billing, and granular permissions on top of everything in Pro. If you're collaborating with others it's the one to pick — happy to walk through the seat pricing whenever you're ready.
fields.csat-comment: Really helpful, upgraded on the spot.

fields.subject: Can I import my notes from Evernote?
fields.body: Switching over from Evernote — is there an importer?
fields.reason: Import how-to. Answer grounded in the Evernote import article; the steps and the background-import note match it.
fields.suggested-reply: Hi Ola! Yes — go to Settings → Data → Import and pick 'Evernote (.enx)'. Upload your export and we'll bring over notes, notebooks (as tags), and attachments. Larger imports run in the background and email you when they're done.
